providers.title: Trace inequalities
providers.scope: In a tracial von Neumann algebra: |tau(ab)| <= ||a||_2 ||b||_2, ||abc||_2 <= ||a|| ||b||_2 ||c||, |tau(ab)| <= ||a|| ||b||_1, and ||b||_1 <= tau(q)^(1/2) ||b||_2 if b = bq.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Haar unitaries in corners
providers.scope: Every nonzero corner qQq of a II_1 factor contains a Haar unitary, and Q has projections of every trace.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Decay of correlations
providers.scope: For a Haar unitary h of qMq and b in M, sum_j |tau(h^j b)|^2 <= tau(q) ||b||_2^2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Freeness with arbitrary outer letters
providers.scope: A Haar unitary t is free from a unital C*-algebra D iff tau(d_0 t^(n_1) d_1 ... t^(n_j) d_j) = 0 for nonzero n_i, centred interior d_i and arbitrary outer d_0, d_j.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Absorption
providers.scope: If t is a Haar unitary free from D and a, b are unitaries of D, then t* and atb are Haar unitaries free from D.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Unitaries lift
providers.scope: A unitary of an ultraproduct of finite factors has a representing sequence of unitaries.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Local quantization in corners
providers.scope: For an irreducible inclusion Q in M, a projection p of Q and finitely many y, there is a projection 0 != q <= p in Q with ||qyq - c_y q||_1 <= alpha tau(q), c_y = tau(pyp)/tau(p).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Approximate independence
providers.scope: For an irreducible inclusion Q in M, finitely many centred letters, a word length n and eps > 0, there is a normal partial isometry v in Q with tau(v*v) > 1/4 and all alternating words of length <= n of trace at most eps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Popa's free independence theorem
providers.scope: For irreducible inclusions Q_n in M_n and countably many centred elements of the ultraproduct, there is a Haar unitary u in the ultraproduct of the Q_n with all alternating words in these elements and nonzero powers of u of trace zero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Free Haar unitaries in ultrapowers
providers.scope: For an irreducible inclusion P in M of II_1 factors and a norm-separable unital C*-algebra D in M^omega, there is a Haar unitary of P^omega, liftable to unitaries of P, free from D.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Haagerup's inequality for words of length one
providers.scope: ||sum b_gamma lambda(gamma)|| <= 2 (sum |b_gamma|^2)^(1/2) over the free generators and their inverses.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Perturbation with uniform correlation
providers.scope: For unitaries u, z, xi in M, 0 < alpha < 1/2 and l >= 1 there are a unitary u' with ||u' - u||_2 <= alpha/sqrt(2l) + 1/l and a word W' in u' and unitaries of P with |tau(xi* W') - (alpha/2) tau(xi* z)| <= ||xi||_2 4 alpha^2/(1 - 2 alpha) + 1/l.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Relative generation
providers.scope: For an irreducible inclusion P in M of II_1 factors with M of separable predual, the unitaries u with W*(P, u) = M form a dense G_delta set for the trace norm (OpenAI, 2026).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Irreducible hyperfinite subfactors
providers.scope: Every irreducible inclusion N in M of II_1 factors with M of separable predual has a copy R_0 of the hyperfinite factor in N with R_0' cap M = C.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Commuting projections from one element
providers.scope: Commuting projections e_m are spectral projections of functions of b = sum 2 3^(-m) e_m.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Four generators
providers.scope: Every II_1 factor with separable predual is generated by four self-adjoint elements.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two by two encoding
providers.scope: If N is generated by four self-adjoint elements, M_2(N) is generated by two.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Single generation of II_1 factors
providers.scope: Every II_1 factor with separable predual is generated by one operator (OpenAI, 2026).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Operations on generators
providers.scope: W*(a+ib) = W*(a,b); spectral projections of a diagonal operator with distinct eigenvalues tending to 0; merging a central self-adjoint generator; two central summands, on a separable Hilbert space.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separability
providers.scope: A von Neumann algebra on a separable Hilbert space is generated by a sequence of self-adjoint contractions, is sigma-finite, and has separable predual.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Properly infinite algebras (Wogen)
providers.scope: A properly infinite von Neumann algebra on a separable Hilbert space is generated by two self-adjoint elements.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite factors
providers.scope: A nonzero finite factor on a separable Hilbert space is M_n(C) or a II_1 factor with separable predual, and is generated by one operator.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Direct integrals (Willig)
providers.scope: If almost every fibre of a direct integral of von Neumann algebras over a standard Borel space is singly generated, the direct integral is generated by the diagonal algebra and one decomposable operator, and is singly generated.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The generator problem
providers.scope: Every von Neumann algebra on a separable Hilbert space is generated by one operator, equivalently by two self-adjoint operators.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Separable predual
providers.scope: Every von Neumann algebra with separable predual is generated by one operator.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An invertible positive generator contains the unit
providers.scope: If c is self-adjoint with spectrum in (0, infinity), the non-unital von Neumann algebra generated by c contains 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Few self-adjoint generators (Dykema-Sinclair-Smith-White)
providers.scope: A II_1 factor generated by n self-adjoint elements has G_sa(M) <= n - 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Compression (Dykema-Sinclair-Smith-White)
providers.scope: G_sa(M) <= t^2 G_sa(pMp) for a projection p of trace t in (0,1) in a II_1 factor M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The generator invariant vanishes (OpenAI)
providers.scope: G(M) = G_sa(M) = 0 for every II_1 factor with separable predual.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
